title: Backend API documentation
description: Interactive OpenAPI docs (Scalar) served by the backend at /swagger: endpoints grouped by domain in the sidebar.

title: Education endpoints
description: The Educational Stress group: create a case, add scenarios, read results, select a scenario, and run the stress model directly.

title: POST /api/simulations/education/
description: Create an education case: the request body schema for the course, its assignments, exams and observed stress.

title: POST …/education/{caseId}/scenarios
description: Run a user what-if against a case: a named list of typed adjustments.

title: POST …/education/stress-model/evaluate
description: Evaluate weeks directly through the stress model and get every intermediate component back.

title: Yard logistics endpoints
description: The Yard Logistics group: ingest simulator runs, add runs, read overviews and run detail, timelines, proposals and the yard image.

title: POST /api/simulations/yard/
description: Create a yard case from one or more simulator runs (the SimulationExportData wrapper).

title: Logistic logs endpoints
description: The Logistic Logs group: ingest kiosk log rows and read the case overview and per-session detail.

title: Trying an endpoint from the docs
description: Scalar's built-in API client sending GET /api/health and showing the live JSON response.

title: Architecture diagram
description: Data flow (your systems → backend API → PostgreSQL) and user flow (browser → backend; browser → Ollama proxy → local LLM), with what runs in Docker vs on the host.
